messages:
maria-ux: Quick heads-up — ran a short screen-reader + keyboard pass on the new model-compare modal. Found a keyboard trap when you open the delta panel (focus never returns to the modal close button).

leo-frontend: oh nice catch, can you paste repro steps?

aisha-a11y: repro: open modal -> Tab to 'Compare' button -> open delta panel (right pane) -> keep tabbing — focus goes into the pane but Shift+Tab doesn't get back to the modal header. NVDA reads the pane as a separate landmark.

maria-ux: Steps confirmed on mac + VoiceOver too. Also low contrast on the tiny 'x' close icon in dark theme — WCAG AA fails on that glyph.

accessibility-bot: Automated contrast scan: .modal-close (dark theme) — ratio 3.6:1 (FAIL, AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text).

devon-design: ugh. I can increase the icon weight or add a rounded high-contrast background. Prefer subtle change so visual density doesn't jump.

leo-frontend: For keyboard trap, I think the delta panel is getting focusable elements but missing aria-hidden toggles on the rest of the modal content. We should set aria-hidden on the main modal when the panel is open, or better: trap focus inside the currently visible panel and put an inert attribute on background nodes.

aisha-a11y: Please don't rely solely on inert polyfills — ensure we have explicit tabIndex management and focus sentinel nodes. Implementation suggestion: add a focus trap sentinel at panel open, on close return focus to the modal close button. Also add aria-label to the close button: 'Close compare modal' for clarity.

sam-pm: Timeline? This is a regression for customers using keyboard navigation. How risky is the fix?

leo-frontend: Small risk. I'll prototype two fixes: (A) aria-hidden + focus trap + return-focus on close, (B) move panel out of modal DOM subtree so it's a sibling and manage modal stacking with aria-modal. A is faster.

devon-design: For contrast, I'll try a 12% lighter icon + 8px circular #ffffff20 backdrop (dark theme) — should pass. I'll post visual shortly.

aisha-a11y: Also verify with high-contrast mode / forced-colors. And test with screen readers: NVDA/JAWS/VO edge cases.

leo-frontend: I'll open a short PR with fix A, add unit for focus return, and a storybook story for keyboard flow. Will include code snippet in PR: 
```js
// on open
previousFocus = document.activeElement;
focusFirstPanelItem();
// on close
if (previousFocus) previousFocus.focus();
```

maria-ux: Thanks — please @aisha-a11y for review before merge. Sam, can we include this in the next patch release (low risk)?

sam-pm: yes, schedule for next patch. Thx all :thumbsup:

accessibility-bot: Contrast re-check reminder scheduled after deploy.
